title: Emissions Trading and Corporate Environmental Disclosure: A Cross-Country Analysis
status: Internal analysis plan recorded after source/schema inspection and before cross-country outcome-model estimation; not externally preregistered.
frame: Organization-years with an observed Boolean TR.PolicyWaterEfficiency, nonfinancial and known sector, organization_id and country. No imputed organization-year gaps. Country labels standardized; ambiguous identity/period conflicts quarantined.
primary_outcome: Availability of finite nonnegative values for BOTH TR.CO2DirectScope1 and TR.CO2IndirectScope2, in the same organization-fiscal year. Zero is observed disclosure. Absence means not captured by the supplied archive, not proven nondisclosure.
exposure: Country-level national/supranational ETS operating context, not firm participation. World Bank historical instrument series and official institutional chronology. Subnational-only contexts distinguished; carbon tax context controlled. No current status backcast.
primary_model: Linear probability association: national ETS indicator, subnational ETS context, national carbon tax, log GDP per capita, GDP growth; country and industry-by-year fixed effects; cluster by common EU/EEA/UK policy family and otherwise country, t(G-1). Main effect not interpreted causally.
secondary_models: Industry and year fixed effects between-country comparison
National ETS by emissions-intensive sector interaction with firm and country-year and industry-year fixed effects
prespecified_sensitivities: Alternative coverage frame union of water-policy and energy-policy observations
Common firms observed in all 2015-2024 years
Country rather than policy-family clustered SE
figures: Country coverage and disclosure profiles including China
Annual disclosed scope coverage by regulatory context
Within-country sector contrast and robustness intervals if estimable; otherwise transparent country time comparison
inference: Primary single outcome. Holm adjustment across four secondary scope coefficients; heterogeneity is secondary, no selective reporting. No significance guarantee or retrospective causal label.
india: Existing randomized particulate-matter experiment retained as separate supporting evidence/appendix, never pooled with CO2 or transported to all countries.
provenance: LSEG licensed source files stay private; code, policy sources, aggregate outputs and identifiers/definitions supplied for authorized reproduction. Published China candidate is not needed for inclusion; use only after provenance/data validation.
timing_details: Fiscal-year labels 2002-2024 as supplied by LSEG define the organization-year unit. Regulatory context and macro controls align to that fiscal-year label. Endpoints must be unique and fall in the labeled year or the following calendar year. Legitimate 52/53-week year endings can generate two distinct fiscal years ending in one calendar year; these are not duplicates and are retained. Exclusion of fiscal/end-calendar-year mismatches is an added timing sensitivity fixed before estimation. Previous-year context is also tested.
policy_details: Voluntary Japanese GX pilot context from 2023 is modeled separately; Kazakhstan 2016-2017 trading suspension is not coded as an operating ETS; Norway national ETS from 2005. Regulatory exposure is year-end context; previous-year context is a timing sensitivity.
